t: A pocket-sized board with a color screen, buttons, sensors, and Wi-Fi.
steps: Buy a Wio Terminal from Seeed Studio or a maker shop.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the Seeed SAMD board package and pick Wio Terminal from the board list.
Plug the board in with a USB-C cable.
Open the Blink example and upload it.
Try the screen and light sensor examples from the Seeed wiki.
Flash the Wi-Fi firmware with Seeed's update tool before your first wireless project.
meta: Open Board. From $31.49. A few stores.
